entities.name: League of Nations
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The first worldwide intergovernmental organization, established in 1920 as part of the Treaty of Versailles. Its mission was to maintain world peace through collective security and dispute resolution. It failed to prevent World War II and was dissolved in 1946.
